interaction_steps.prompt:
如题。
etcd打开了rbac authentication。但discov.EtcdConf中没有user等字段，无法进行身份认证。连接etcd时会报错：
etcdserver: user name is empty

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; sed -n '1,180p' core/discov/config.go; sed -n '260,335p' core/discov/internal/registry.go; sed -n '1,120p' core/discov/config_test.go; sed -n '1,100p' core/discov/internal/etcdclient.go; rg -n 'EtcdConf|etcd.*(user|password)|Username|Password' --glob '*.go' | head -100"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'Registry|GetConn|Monitor\\(' core/discov/*.go; sed -n '1,220p' core/discov/clients.go; cat go.mod | head"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' core/discov/publisher.go; sed -n '1,100p' core/discov/subscriber.go; sed -n '1,100p' core/discov/clients_test.go; rg -n 'NewPublisher|NewSubscriber' core/discov"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' zrpc/server.go; sed -n '1,100p' zrpc/internal/rpcpubserver.go; sed -n '1,140p' zrpc/client.go; sed -n '1,120p' zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go; rg -n 'BuildDiscovTarget|discov.*Target' zrpc"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'getCluster\\(|GetConn\\(|Monitor\\(|NewClient = func|NewClient\\(' core/discov --glob '*.go'; rg -n 'NewRpcPubServer\\(' --glob '*.go'; git diff --stat && git diff -- core/discov/config.go zrpc/internal/target.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'Etcd:|etcd:' readme-cn.md readme.md zrpc core/discov | head -80; gofmt -w core/discov/config.go core/discov/internal/registry.go core/discov/internal/registry_test.go core/discov/publisher.go core/discov/subscriber.go core/discov/clients_test.go zrpc/client.go zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go zrpc/internal/rpcpubserver.go zrpc/internal/target.go zrpc/server.go; git diff --check; git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'google.golang.org/grpc ' go.mod; git diff -- core/discov/internal/registry.go core/discov/publisher.go core/discov/subscriber.go zrpc/internal/resolver/discovbuilder.go zrpc/server.go zrpc/client.go zrpc/internal/rpcpubserver.go"
